summary: OpenAI published a case study describing how legal tech company Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 financial documents, find four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in a financial-review workflow.

practices.reason: The document reports a customer's own internal test results on document review accuracy, which is illustrative but not a transferable benchmark an engineering team could run.
practices.quote: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow.
